operator_direction: Replace the arbitrary modem chirps with a standards-shaped V.25/V.22bis 2400-baud boot sequence, mount the existing verified FAT32 card at the fastest stable clock with bounded fallback, and dynamically discover all games copied under SD GAMES.

ota_data.live_policy: mutable boot-selection state; preserve without writing

predecessor.manual_result: 0.4.4 booted and fixed full-capacity USB MSC writes, but its arbitrary modem chirps were rejected and its 1 MHz SD clock caused a clean 32 GB FAT32 volume to time out during macOS mount and remain unavailable to the launcher

sd_bundle.filesystem: MBR FAT32 named P4GAMES; ExFAT rejected

runtime_contract: submit the official 768x480 landscape logo before storage or audio work
play V.25/V.22bis-shaped 1300, 2100, 1200, 1800, and 2400 Hz call/training phases instead of arbitrary chirps
try Waveshare SD at 10 MHz, 5 MHz, 1 MHz, then 400 kHz and log the selected frequency

load executable games only from microSD GAMES/*.P4G with root compatibility
enforce an external USB FAT32 P4GAMES target in the Waveshare installer
never initiate a card format from firmware

execution_contract.sd_write_route: exclusive H2 USB-device MSC after successor boot; verified FAT32 /GAMES package copy

acceptance_required_after_install: official logo is the first useful frame
555-1212 plays before a recognizable structured V.22bis-style 2400-baud sequence
SD_READY reports the fastest stable clock selected from the fallback ladder

clean host eject remounts the card and the launcher dynamically discovers all 12 packages
the OTA application contains no enabled P4G payload
no panic, watchdog, display timeout, concurrent filesystem ownership, or failed verified host write occurs
